speeches.speaker: Mark Dreyfus
speeches.brief: Introduced a companion bill setting the legislative framework for the new marriage celebrant registration charge, capped by statute at $600 from 1 July 2013 and indexed in future years to the consumer price index, with a lower introductory rate flagged for the first year.

speeches.speaker: Anthony Albanese
speeches.brief: Moved that the Marriage Amendment (Celebrant Administration and Fees) Bill 2013, Marriage (Celebrant Registration Charge) Bill 2013 and Therapeutic Goods Amendment (2013 Measures No. 1) Bill 2013 be referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration.

speeches.speaker: Teresa Gambaro
speeches.brief: Spoke on the Marriage Celebrant bills, quoting a submission from Marriage Celebrants Australia noting 70 per cent of Australians choose a civil ceremony while religious celebrants, used by the other 30 per cent, avoid the new fee, and said the average celebrant performs seven weddings a year for a gross income of about $3,500.
